steps.title: Prepare extraction buffers
steps.instruction: Make 2×CTAB solution containing 2 % (w/v) CTAB, 100 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, 1.4 M NaCl and 20 mM EDTA pH 8.0; make high‑salt precipitation solution containing 1.2 M NaCl and 0.8 M sodium citrate; prepare TE buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl, 1 mM EDTA, pH 8.0); keep 10 mg ml⁻¹ RNase (Nippon Gene) on ice.

steps.title: Pre‑heat CTAB solution
steps.instruction: Place the 2×CTAB solution in a water bath and heat to 60 °C, then add 2 % (v/v) 2‑mercaptoethanol immediately before use.

steps.title: Homogenize leaf tissue
steps.instruction: Grind 100 mg fresh citrus leaf in liquid nitrogen, add 800 µL of the pre‑heated 2×CTAB solution, vortex until fully suspended, and transfer the mixture to a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: RNase treatment
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL of the 10 mg ml⁻¹ RNase to the tube, mix by inversion, and incubate at 37 °C for 15 minutes (RNase treatment is performed before protein denaturation with chloroform).

steps.title: Protein denaturation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 56 °C for 30 minutes, inverting the tube once every 10 minutes.

steps.title: First chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL chloroform, mix gently on a tube rotator for 15 minutes, then carefully transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Second chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Repeat the addition of 300 µL chloroform, 15‑minute gentle mixing, and transfer of the aqueous supernatant to a fresh 2 mL tube.

steps.title: High‑salt precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer 600 µL of the combined supernatant to a 1.5 mL tube, add 300 µL high‑salt precipitation solution, and mix by inversion.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL isopropanol to the tube and mix by inversion to precipitate DNA.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, leaving the often‑transparent DNA pellet behind.

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 1000 µL 70 % ethanol, invert the tube 10 times to wash away salts, then completely remove the ethanol supernatant.

steps.title: Dry and resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the DNA pellet until all ethanol evaporates, then dissolve the pellet in 100 µL TE buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl, 1 mM EDTA, pH 8.0).
